            need(set(item) == {"path", "bytes", "sha256", "mode"} and item["path"] == path,
                 "entire-original-input-record")
            add_file("inputs/%04d-%s" % (i, Path(path).name), path, item)
        evidence = plan["execution_evidence"]
        need(type(evidence) is list and evidence, "original-execution-receipt-files-required")
        roles = set()
        for i, item in enumerate(evidence):
            need(set(item) == {"role", "path", "bytes", "sha256", "mode"}
                 and type(item["role"]) is str and item["role"] and item["role"] not in roles,
                 "explicit-unique-original-execution-evidence-role")
            roles.add(item["role"])
            add_file("execution/%04d-%s" % (i, Path(item["path"]).name), item["path"], item)
        add_file("execution/seal-plan.json", args.plan)
        for name, item in package["files"].items():
            add_file("pure-reader-source/"+name, HERE/name, item)
        add_file("pure-reader-source/source-manifest.json", HERE/"source-manifest.json")
        manifest = {"schema": archive.MEMBER_SCHEMA, "native_output": str(native_root),
            "native_report_sha256": report_pin["sha256"],
            "native_original_status": native["status"], "files": files, "directories": directories,
            "synthetic_container_directories": sorted(synthetic),
            "file_count": len(files), "directory_count": len(directories),
            "payload_bytes": sum(item["bytes"] for item in files.values()),
            "input_bindings": declared_inputs, "execution_evidence": evidence,
            "source_profile_sha256": profile_meta["sha256"],
            "mode_policy": "Every file retains its real source mode. Native directory modes are exact; explicitly synthetic container directories use0700.",
            "manifest_is_outside_archive": True,
            "native_Torch_compiler_or_recorded_admission_executed": False}
        manifest_meta = write(output/"file-manifest.json", manifest)
        same(data(output/"file-manifest.json", manifest_meta["sha256"],
                  manifest_meta["bytes"], manifest_meta["mode"]), manifest,
             "full-sealed-member-manifest-readback")
        archive_meta = archive.create_archive(output/"complete.tar.xz", manifest)
        archive_check = archive.verify_archive(output/"complete.tar.xz", manifest, archive_meta)
        original_check = archive.verify_originals(manifest)
        need(native["all_inputs_unchanged"] is True and native["input_recheck_errors"] == [],
             "original-native-input-recheck-preserved")
        result.update(status="PASS_CUSTODY_ONLY", native_original_status=native["status"],
            original_report_sha256=report_pin["sha256"],
            original_case_count=24, case_summaries=case_summaries,
            original_bounded_control_count=5, bounded_control_summaries=control_summaries,
            original_input_count=len(declared_inputs), original_native_inputs_unchanged=True,
            original_case_counts={
                "reference_cases": {"case_count": 24, **{key: native[key] for key in (
                    "passed", "failed", "blocked", "original_event_count", "completed_reference_events")}},
                "bounded_controls": {key: controls[key] for key in (
                    "case_count", "passed", "failed", "status", "Torch_parity_claim")}},
            file_manifest={**manifest_meta, "path": str(output/"file-manifest.json")},
            archive={**archive_meta, "path": str(output/"complete.tar.xz")},
            archive_verification=archive_check, original_verification=original_check,
            all_original_files_unchanged=True, native_admission_eligible=native["status"] == "PASS")
        binding = {"schema": archive.BINDING_SCHEMA, "status": "RAW_BYTES_SEALED",
            "profile_sha256": profile_meta["sha256"],
            "member_manifest": result["file_manifest"], "archive": result["archive"],
            "native_report": report_pin, "native_output": str(native_root),
            "native_status": native["status"], "native_case_counts": result["original_case_counts"],
            "execution_evidence": evidence, "input_bindings": declared_inputs,
            "sealing_report": None, "no_new_native_Torch_or_compiler_execution": True}
        exit_code = 0
    except BaseException as error:
        result["status"] = "FAIL"
        result["errors"].append({"type": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error),
                                 "traceback": traceback.format_exc()})
    finally:
        errors = recheck_bound()
        result.update(input_recheck_errors=errors, checked_inputs=BOUND,
                      forbidden_execution_attempts=dict(AUDIT))
        if errors or any(AUDIT.values()):
            result["status"], exit_code = "FAIL", 1
        report_meta = write(output/"report.json", result)
        if exit_code == 0:
            binding["sealing_report"] = {**report_meta, "path": str(output/"report.json")}
            write(output/"evidence-binding.json", binding)
    return exit_code

if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

read is permitted. The original native status is reconstructed, not relabelled.
"""

import hashlib
import importlib.util

import traceback

_COMMON_SHA = "a4ac713abf15756548d6b0be15c1d8287f73e6f4dee40a812415c1daf160f207"

if hashlib.sha256(_common_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != _COMMON_SHA:
    raise AssertionError("exact-pure-common-source-required-before-import")

_common = importlib.util.module_from_spec(_spec)
sys.modules["admission_common"] = _common
_spec.loader.exec_module(_common)
from admission_common import SHA, BOUND, AUDIT, need, read, data, write, same, load, recheck_bound


def original_top(profile, context, cases, controls):

        "status":"PREPARING", "case_count":24, "reference_case_count":24,
        "reference_sha256":None, "case_contract_sha256":profile["reference"]["case_contract_sha256"],
        "source_revision":"sum-integral-source01", "source_sha256":None,
        "native_sha256":None, "functions":None, "units":None,
        "descriptor_bytes":672, "state_format":"HTSINT01", "backing_format":"HTOSIN01",
        "native_executed":False, "Torch_executed":False, "compiler_executed":False,
        "schema_closure":False, "full_project_status":"HOLD", "cases":cases,
        "all_observations_supported":False,
        "all24_execution_index":[{"index":i,"status":"NOT_RUN"} for i in range(24)],
        "bounded_api_controls":{"status":"NOT_RUN","Torch_parity_claim":False}}
    result.update(reference_admission=context["reference_admission"],
        build_admission=context["build_admission"],

        actual_build_binding_sha256=profile["actual_build_binding"]["sha256"],
        actual_reference_binding_sha256=profile["reference_binding"]["sha256"])
    # This object reconstructs the original producer. The containing pure report
    # separately declares that no native process or new Tensor observation ran.
    result["native_executed"] = True
    need(len(cases) == 24 and [row["index"] for row in cases] == list(range(24)),
         "all24-original-case-results-reconstructed")
    for row in cases:
        result["all24_execution_index"][row["index"]] = {"index":row["index"],"status":row["status"]}
    result["passed"] = sum(row["status"] == "PASS" for row in cases)
    result["blocked"] = sum(row["status"] == "BLOCKED" for row in cases)
    result["failed"] = sum(row["status"] == "FAIL" for row in cases)
    result["original_event_count"] = sum(len(row["events"]) for row in reference["rows"])
    result["completed_reference_events"] = sum(len(row["completed_reference_events"]) for row in cases)
    need(result["passed"]+result["blocked"]+result["failed"] == 24 and
         result["original_event_count"] == reference["operation_totals"]["attempted"] == 260,
         "complete24-and-actual260-event-denominators")
    result["bounded_api_controls"] = controls
    complete = (result["passed"] == 24 and
                result["completed_reference_events"] == result["original_event_count"] and
                result["bounded_api_controls"]["status"] == "PASS_BOUNDED_API_CONTROLS_ONLY")
    result["status"] = "FAIL" if result["failed"] or result["bounded_api_controls"]["status"] != "PASS_BOUNDED_API_CONTROLS_ONLY" else "PASS" if complete else "BLOCKED"
    result["all_observations_supported"] = complete
    result["exact_Python_diagnostic_text_generated_by_native"] = False
    result["exception_scope"] = "Original exact text retained; real native acceptance/cause/payload/full owner rollback compared. No diagnostic text is synthesized."
    errors = context["replay"].unchanged_inputs(context["inputs"])
    result["input_recheck_errors"] = errors
    result["all_inputs_unchanged"] = not errors
    result["checked_inputs"] = {name:value["record"] for name,value in context["inputs"].items()}
    if errors:
        result["status"] = "FAIL"
    return result

                          reference_events_recomputed=260, bounded_controls_recomputed=5,
                          original_top_report_reconstructed_bytes=len(original_raw),
                          original_top_report_reconstructed_sha256=SHA(original_raw),
                          all_original_fields_compared=True)
            exit_code = 0
    except BaseException as error:
        result.update(status="FAIL", error={"type": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error),
                                           "traceback": traceback.format_exc()})
    finally:
        if archive is not None and member_manifest is not None:
            try:
                result["original_member_final_recheck"] = archive.verify_originals(member_manifest)
            except BaseException as error:
                result["member_recheck_error"] = repr(error)
                result["status"], exit_code = "FAIL", 1
        errors = recheck_bound()
        result.update(input_recheck_errors=errors, all_inputs_unchanged=not errors,
                      checked_inputs=BOUND, forbidden_execution_attempts=dict(AUDIT))
        if errors or any(AUDIT.values()):
            result["status"], exit_code = "FAIL", 1
        write(output/"report.json", result)
    return exit_code

if __name__ == "__main__":

# Integral24 complete raw custody and recorded admission

## Status and scope

This is a source-only candidate. It has not been imported, AST checked, run,
sealed, or used to admit a native result. The author has made no new process,
Torch, Tensor, compiler, emitter, or H request while preparing this package.
The target ROG directory is /home/qian-qi/heptatorch-continuation-20261116/runs/sum-integral-pure-admission-source-01.
The two H hosts were unavailable during authoring. Remote persistence/readback
and actual execution remain separate root-owned steps.

The package is bound to the completed original output at
/home/qian-qi/heptatorch-continuation-20261116/runs/root-sum-integral-native24-source01-actual-01.
Its full report is 5,722,831 bytes, SHA256
5f8f9a7b4dbf6455c628a78b392c79d06ff83beecb9eca0caa940f91b85e700b.
The report was not wholly retrieved by this author. Its declared status and
a process exit code do not establish independent admission. The programs below
must read the entire original report and evidence tree before any result exists.

There are two separate denominators:

* The immutable fixed-PyTorch comparison has 24 cases and all 260 events.
* Five original native dtype refusal controls are additional bounded API
  controls. They are not reference cases and make no Torch parity claim.

The actual source is afd54444849ed10f7b4af53231c9db6542854b70f33e3927f8b05dfbb23ed1e3,
with 699 functions, 9,300 blocks, 33,297 instructions, 14 fresh units,
HTSINT01/HTOSIN01 and 672-byte descriptors. The actual ELF is
fec4f5cd7f80591fee98378cb5a8a85b6e71c5e4a7f0a00a739dad16afc24c28.
The exact native24 package, actual build binding, cold build, reference24,
native parent package and emitted source are admitted by their original frozen
readers. No earlier 696 PASS is reused as a 699 result.

## Complete raw sealing

seal_raw.py reads the actual top report with its exact full SHA, byte length and
mode. It checks every embedded case and bounded-control report against its whole
original file. It inventories the entire original output directory, with no
filter or selected-case subset, and includes all original declared input files,
all root-supplied original execution evidence, this entire source package and
the exact seal plan.

Every archived file keeps its original mode and full bytes. Original directory
modes are retained; newly invented container directories alone are explicitly
0700. The uncompressed TAR is fully hashed, every member is checked, and exactly
one complete XZ stream plus the physical EOF is required. TAR padding after its
first EOF must contain only zero bytes. Links, sparse files, duplicate members,
undeclared members and silent path escapes are rejected.

Sealing is custody only. It preserves the actual producer status, including
FAIL or BLOCKED, and cannot produce a semantic admission. A successful seal
writes file-manifest.json, complete.tar.xz, report.json and evidence-binding.json
outside the original native directory. The original tree and every bound input
are checked again. The original report is never rewritten.

## Recorded reference-case admission

admit_recorded_integral24.py first repeats source, reference, actual build, full
archive and original-input admission. It imports the immutable native24 Case,
its original parent comparator, native observer, Memory decoder and strict owner
module from the frozen native source package. The entire IntegralCase factory
is 21,626 bytes / 63d30c09f7c2883fc9b6503eaa1822ac7a4045fa5cd54a5ff7cfdd21be9ce833.
The original Native constructor is 2,514 bytes /
3ed7a51cb5ee0879851b47890f9fa62ec88bef246fd3f37f222150f990571bc5.
Neither body nor any Case method is overridden.

The recorded transport requires every newly generated packet to equal the
original archived request byte for byte before returning the original response.
All original frames must be consumed. Frame headers, command prefixes, the
partial-backward payload, capability publication/drop, full blank trailing
streams and original dual EOF are checked independently. The current IMAGE
literal is the sole change to recorded_wire.py; the entire class is unchanged
from the a096 parent and has its original four-edit inverse to the 20b23 reader.

complete_owners.py is unchanged in its entirety. It consumes every actual
complete before/after owner pair, verifies raw compressed blobs and adjacent
endpoint equality, and supplies real archived memory to the original decoder.
Original Case owner archives must equal the corresponding complete frame bytes.
A nonzero frame-header status requires the original complete owner rollback.
A nonzero command58 payload remains a distinct partial-backward result.
The strict 117 rule still receives complete raw bytes and applies its original
exact publication-field inverse. No descriptor page or Tensor region is omitted.

All original Case checks, raw logical/storage words, u64 values, offsets,
strides, Versions, lifetime and identity relations, RNG and errors are rerun
against those original bytes. No host Tensor arithmetic, tolerance, NaN
canonicalization, expected-value model or summary-derived read is introduced.

## Five bounded controls

typed_scope_controls.py and its entire run_controls body are used unchanged:
4,730 bytes / 585f86c949b0ed8d7424dbf5d3aa87429a528ace503c11bc8d70ec99db89183a.
The driver is called once and starts all five original recorded contexts in its
original order. Its original numerical inputs, cause7, full owner byte equality,
structure, all 5,056 RNG bytes, drop/audit and EOF checks are not replaced.

Controls export complete frame owner journals and two extra manual capture_owner
records, but do not export the ordinary Case owner_records/owners archives.
control_owners.py therefore keeps the entire original 4,647-byte frame-validation
constructor prefix, then checks this distinct original report shape. Each extra
manual reference must be the corresponding real exported endpoint and command
side. Its complete raw bytes are decoded and verified at the exact original
frame and capture order. No empty Case ledger or inferred state is constructed.

Every case report, all five control reports, their summary and the complete
original top report must be reconstructed byte for byte. An unavailable
observation or mismatch fails; none is silently marked supported. A future pure
PASS requires all 24 cases / 260 events and, separately, all five controls.
The pure outer result always says native_executed=false. Historical fields
inside the reconstructed original report retain the original producer values.

## Source ancestry

source-adaptation.json gives a whole-file forward and reverse transform for
every one of the 19 files in the original a096 pure32 source package, including
the renamed entry point. The complete parent manifest is included. Existing
source02 archive-shadow correction evidence is copied unchanged. The original
20b23 pure reader and f13a native32 manifest are also included unchanged.
The new native24 manifest is included as exact source evidence.

The four common original byte helper bodies and whole recorded transport inverse
are verified by source_custody.py, as are the new complete current file set, all
source bytes/modes, both native package chains, original Case, original control
body and Native constructor. Parent FAIL history is preserved and not admitted
or reclassified by this package. Original Sum32 and original76 are not replayed.

## Root-owned future execution

All templates use /usr/bin/python3 -I -S -B and create-only distinct outputs.
They are not submitted requests. A root-owned external request must insert the
actual final source manifest SHA and a separately frozen actual seal plan.

The seal plan already identifies the exact known native report, but remains
PENDING until the original execution request, status and complete stream/EOF
receipts have been supplied as exact nonempty evidence records. No receipt,
terminal state or archive SHA is invented. After actual sealing, a separate
recorded-admission request must bind the newly written evidence-binding SHA.
Use --prepare-only to admit the complete inputs without replay; use
--admit-recorded only for the full original recorded comparison.

No full schema, resource-failure, arbitrary transition or full-project closure
is claimed. Full project status remains HOLD.

files.control_owners.py:
"""Integral control endpoints; the original Case owner reader stays unchanged.

Controls do not export Case.owner_records/owners archives. This class validates
their actual complete frame journal plus the two explicitly exported manual
capture_owner records. It does not invent an empty Case ledger or omit a page.
"""
from collections import OrderedDict
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re

from admission_common import SHA, need, read, same
from complete_owners import CompleteOwners


class CompleteControlOwners(CompleteOwners):
    def __init__(self, directory, report, session, owner_module):
        self.directory, self.report = Path(directory), report
        self.session, self.module = session, owner_module
        self.blobs = report["complete_frame_owner_blobs"]
        same(session.transport["owner_blobs"], self.blobs,
             "transport-and-case-complete-owner-blob-ledger")
        raw = read(self.directory / "owner-frames.jsonl")
        need(raw.endswith(b"\n") and raw, "complete-nonempty-owner-journal-EOF")
        lines = raw.splitlines()
        need(all(lines), "no-empty-owner-journal-record")
        self.journal = [json.loads(line) for line in lines]
        need(len(self.journal) == report["complete_frame_count"] == len(session.requests),
             "one-original-complete-owner-pair-per-frame")
        self.cache, self.capture_cursor = OrderedDict(), 0
        self.seen_digests, self.current_reads = set(), 0
        self.captured_endpoints = 0
        self.frame_refusals, self.partial_payload_errors = 0, 0
        self.rollback_bytes = 0
        referenced = set()
        previous = None
        for index, row in enumerate(self.journal, 1):
            need(set(row) == {"frame", "request_sha256", "request_bytes", "commands", "before",
                 "response_sha256", "response_bytes", "after", "frame_status", "record_count", "checks"},
                 "complete-successful-observer-journal-fields", frame=index)
            request, response = session.requests[index-1], session.responses[index-1]
            status, records, commands = session.decoded[index-1]
            need(row["frame"] == index and row["request_sha256"] == SHA(request)
                 and row["request_bytes"] == len(request) and row["response_sha256"] == SHA(response)
                 and row["response_bytes"] == len(response), "raw-wire-journal-binding", frame=index)
            same(row["commands"], [list(command) for command in commands],
                 "exact-journal-command-words")
            need(row["frame_status"] == status and row["record_count"] == len(records),
                 "actual-wire-header-status-and-record-count", frame=index)
            for label, frame in (("before", index-1), ("after", index)):
                ref = row[label]
                need(set(ref) == {"label", "frame", "pointer", "length", "sha256", "verified_summary"},
                     "complete-original-endpoint-fields", frame=index, phase=label)
                need(ref["label"] == label and ref["frame"] == frame
                     and type(ref["pointer"]) is int and ref["pointer"] >= 0
                     and type(ref["length"]) is int and 0 <= ref["length"] <= 64*(1 << 20)
                     and (ref["pointer"] == 0) == (ref["length"] == 0),
                     "exact-endpoint-state-and-length", frame=index, phase=label)
                need(ref["sha256"] in self.blobs, "declared-complete-endpoint-blob")
                entry = self.blobs[ref["sha256"]]
                need(set(entry) == {"path", "bytes", "sha256", "compressed_bytes", "compressed_sha256", "mode"}
                     and entry["sha256"] == ref["sha256"] and entry["bytes"] == ref["length"]
                     and entry["path"] == "complete-owner/"+ref["sha256"]+".bin.xz",
                     "whole-owner-ledger-and-canonical-name")
                referenced.add(ref["sha256"])
            if previous is not None:
                need(all(previous[key] == row["before"][key]
                         for key in ("pointer", "length", "sha256")),
                     "after-N-equals-before-N-plus-one-complete-owner", frame=index)
                # SHA binding is independently checked against the complete bytes
                # when every capture is consumed; neither endpoint is synthesized.
            previous = row["after"]
            if status:
                need(all(row["before"][key] == row["after"][key]
                         for key in ("pointer", "length", "sha256")),
                     "original-header-error-whole-owner-rollback", frame=index)
                self.frame_refusals += 1
                self.rollback_bytes += row["before"]["length"]
            for record in records:
                if record["opcode"] == 58 and record["value"] != 0:
                    need(status == 0, "partial-backward-payload-is-not-a-frame-error", frame=index)
                    self.partial_payload_errors += 1
        need(referenced == set(self.blobs), "no-missing-or-unreferenced-complete-owner-member")
        need(report["full_transition_recomputed"] is False,
             "original-general-transition-scope-preserved")
        need(set(report) == {"index", "name", "status", "scope", "Torch_parity_claim",
             "reference_case", "checks", "observations", "error", "frames", "exit_code",
             "complete_frame_count", "complete_frame_owner_blobs", "full_transition_recomputed",
             "schema_closure", "full_project_status"}, "exact-original-bounded-control-report")
        need(type(report["index"]) is int and 0 <= report["index"] < 5
             and report["scope"] == "native bounded dtype dispatch only"
             and report["Torch_parity_claim"] is False and report["reference_case"] is None
             and report["schema_closure"] is False and report["full_project_status"] == "HOLD",
             "five-native-controls-have-no-invented-Torch-or-Case-ledger")
        observations = report["observations"]
        need(set(observations) == {"command", "frame_status", "record_count",
             "request_hex", "request_sha256", "response_hex", "response_sha256",
             "before_owner", "after_owner"}, "complete-control-observation-fields")
        before, after = observations["before_owner"], observations["after_owner"]
        need(type(before["frame"]) is int and after["frame"] == before["frame"]+1
             and 0 <= before["frame"] < len(self.journal),
             "one-real-wire-command-between-manual-control-endpoints")
        row = self.journal[before["frame"]]
        need(row["frame"] == after["frame"] and row["commands"] == [observations["command"]]
             and observations["command"][0] == 115,
             "control-manual-endpoints-bind-the-actual-command115-frame")
        need(observations["frame_status"] == row["frame_status"]
             and observations["record_count"] == row["record_count"],
             "control-refusal-status-from-original-frame")
        request = session.requests[before["frame"]]
        response = session.responses[before["frame"]]
        need(observations["request_hex"] == request.hex()
             and observations["request_sha256"] == SHA(request)
             and observations["response_hex"] == response.hex()
             and observations["response_sha256"] == SHA(response),
             "complete-control-wire-bytes-not-summary-values")
        self.manual_references = {
            "bounded-dtype-before": before,
            "bounded-dtype-after": after}
        self.manual_capture_cursor = 0
        for phase, label in (("before", "bounded-dtype-before"),
                             ("after", "bounded-dtype-after")):
            reference = self.manual_references[label]
            need(set(reference) == {"label", "frame", "pointer", "length", "sha256", "verified_summary"}
                 and reference["label"] == label, "original-manual-control-capture-fields")
            endpoint = self.endpoint(reference["frame"])
            same({key: reference[key] for key in reference if key != "label"},
                 {key: endpoint[key] for key in endpoint if key != "label"},
                 "manual-control-owner-is-complete-exported-frame-endpoint")
            same({key: reference[key] for key in reference if key != "label"},
                 {key: row[phase][key] for key in row[phase] if key != "label"},
                 "manual-control-owner-is-the-correct-command-side")

    def capture(self, label, frame):
        if label in ("before", "after"):
            return super().capture(label, frame)
        order = ("bounded-dtype-before", "bounded-dtype-after")
        need(self.manual_capture_cursor < 2 and label == order[self.manual_capture_cursor]
             and self.capture_cursor == 2*frame,
             "exact-original-manual-control-capture-order", label=label, frame=frame)
        expected = self.manual_references[label]
        need(frame == expected["frame"], "manual-capture-at-original-recorded-frame")
        raw_owner = self.current(frame)
        raw = raw_owner["bytes"]
        reference = {"label": label, "frame": frame, "pointer": raw_owner["pointer"],
                     "length": raw_owner["length"], "sha256": SHA(raw)}
        snapshot = self.module.decode_owner(raw, raw_owner["pointer"])
        reference["verified_summary"] = self.module.verify_snapshot(snapshot)
        same(reference, expected, "entire-manual-control-owner-observation-recomputed")
        self.manual_capture_cursor += 1
        self.seen_digests.add(reference["sha256"])
        return snapshot, reference, raw

    def finish(self, frames):
        need(frames == len(self.journal) and self.capture_cursor == 2*frames
             and self.seen_digests == set(self.blobs),
             "all-original-control-frame-endpoints-consumed")
        need(self.manual_capture_cursor == 2, "both-original-manual-control-endpoints-consumed")
        return {"frames": frames, "complete_endpoints": self.captured_endpoints,
                "complete_owner_members": len(self.blobs),
                "manual_control_captures": self.manual_capture_cursor,
                "Case_owner_archive_claim": False,
                "recorded_memory_reads": self.current_reads,
                "frame_header_refusals": self.frame_refusals,
                "whole_owner_rollback_bytes": self.rollback_bytes,
                "partial_backward_payload_errors": self.partial_payload_errors,
                "full_general_transition_recomputed": False}


def owners_for_record(directory, report, session, owner_module):
    directory = Path(directory)
    if re.fullmatch(r"case-[0-9]{2}", directory.name):
        need("owner_records" in report and "owner_blobs" in report
             and "reference_case" not in report,
             "original-reference-Case-keeps-complete-Case-owner-contract")
        return CompleteOwners(directory, report, session, owner_module)
    need(directory.parent.name == "bounded-api-controls"
         and re.fullmatch(r"control-0[0-4]", directory.name)
         and int(directory.name[-2:]) == report["index"]
         and "owner_records" not in report and "owner_blobs" not in report,
         "separate-original-control-directory-and-schema")
    return CompleteControlOwners(directory, report, session, owner_module)

"""Run the five immutable bounded controls over their own original tapes.

This module does not replace run_controls or any check inside it. Its Native
factory selects one separately archived control directory before the original
constructor runs. No empty Case owner ledger, expected Tensor or process is made.
"""
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
import json

from admission_common import SHA, need, read, same


def replay_controls(context, factory, owner, case_args, native_root, output, expected):
    controls = context["controls"]
    original_root = Path(native_root)/"bounded-api-controls"
    output = Path(output)
    same(json.loads(read(original_root/"report.json")), expected,
         "entire-original-control-summary-is-in-native-report")
    need(expected["schema"] == "heptatorch.sum-integral.bounded-dtype-controls.v1"
         and expected["case_count"] == len(expected["cases"]) == len(controls.CONTROLS) == 5
         and [row["index"] for row in expected["cases"]] == list(range(5))
         and expected["Torch_parity_claim"] is False
         and expected["schema_closure"] is False and expected["full_project_status"] == "HOLD",
         "five-bounded-controls-remain-separate-from24-reference-cases")
    for index, ((name, dtype, raw, target_dtype), report) in enumerate(
            zip(controls.CONTROLS, expected["cases"])):
        need(report["name"] == name and report["reference_case"] is None
             and report["Torch_parity_claim"] is False,
             "original-control-source-input-and-report-identity", index=index)
        same(json.loads(read(original_root/("control-%02d" % index)/"report.json")),
             report, "whole-original-control-report-embedded-in-summary")
    started, details = [], []

    def recorded_control_native(binary, source, protocol, directory):
        index = len(started)
        need(index < 5 and Path(directory) == output/("control-%02d" % index),
             "all-five-controls-in-original-order-with-no-extra-constructor")
        if index:
            details.append(factory.completed())
        facade = factory.begin(original_root/("control-%02d" % index),
                               expected["cases"][index], Path(directory))
        started.append(index)
        return facade.Native(binary, source, protocol, directory)

    values = dict(vars(factory.facade))
    values["Native"] = recorded_control_native
    control_facade = SimpleNamespace(**values)
    current = controls.run_controls(control_facade, owner, case_args, output)
    need(started == list(range(5)), "all-five-original-controls-actually-recomputed")
    details.append(factory.completed())
    need(len(details) == 5, "five-complete-original-control-EOF-admissions")
    same(current, expected, "entire-original-controls-report-recomputed-without-projection")
    for index in range(5):
        relative = Path("control-%02d" % index)/"report.json"
        need((output/relative).read_bytes() == read(original_root/relative),
             "whole-original-control-report-bytes-reconstructed", index=index)
    summary_raw = read(original_root/"report.json")
    need((output/"report.json").read_bytes() == summary_raw,
         "whole-original-five-control-summary-bytes-reconstructed")
    need(current["status"] == "PASS_BOUNDED_API_CONTROLS_ONLY"
         and current["passed"] == 5 and current["failed"] == 0,
         "each-control-recomputed-success-does-not-claim-Torch-parity")
    return current, {
        "case_count": 5, "controls_recomputed": len(details),
        "reference_cases_added": 0, "Torch_parity_claim": False,
        "complete_owner_admissions": details,
        "control_report_bytes": len(summary_raw), "control_report_sha256": SHA(summary_raw),
        "all_original_fields_and_report_bytes_compared": True,
        "native_executed_here": False, "full_general_transition_recomputed": False}
